ReportQueryDefinition.Name: Пакетная выборка данных для печати конвертов
ReportQueryDefinition.Command: SELECT m.id AS mail_id, m.to_zip AS ind_to, m.to_str1 AS str_to1, m.to_str2 AS str_to2, m.to_str3 AS str_to3, m.to_str4 AS str_to4, m.to_str5 AS str_to5, m.to_str6 AS str_to6, s.post_zip AS ind_from, s.post_str1 AS str_from1, s.post_str2 AS str_from2, s.post_str3 AS str_from3, s.post_str4 AS str_from4, s.post_str5 AS str_from5, s.post_str6 AS str_from6, m.note AS prim, m.copy_count AS copyes, m.is_vip AS vip, NOW() AS date_print FROM mails m JOIN counterparties s ON m.sender_id = s.id WHERE m.id IN (:SelectedMailIds) ORDER BY m.id ASC;

SELECT m.id AS mail_id, m.to_zip AS ind_to, m.to_str1 AS str_to1, m.to_str2 AS str_to2, m.to_str3 AS str_to3, m.to_str4 AS str_to4, m.to_str5 AS str_to5, m.to_str6 AS str_to6, s.post_zip AS ind_from, s.post_str1 AS str_from1, s.post_str2 AS str_from2, s.post_str3 AS str_from3, s.post_str4 AS str_from4, s.post_str5 AS str_from5, s.post_str6 AS str_from6, m.note AS prim, m.copy_count AS copyes, m.is_vip AS vip, datetime('now') AS date_print FROM mails m JOIN counterparties s ON m.sender_id = s.id WHERE m.id IN (:SelectedMailIds) ORDER BY m.id ASC;
